[[Major/Legends|Major]] '''Horst''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who was stationed on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Danuta]]. During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Horst was present in the [[Danuta research facility]] that contained [[Death Star plans/Legends|technical data]] for an Imperial [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] known as the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]], or as it later came to be known, the Death Star. While he was the officer-of-the-day, the facility was [[Operation Skyhook|raided]] by the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Kyle Katarn]], hired by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to steal the Death Star data. Horst was alerted to some explosion and attempted to eliminate the rebel threat, only to have his command car shot down and destroyed.

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Horst joined the military ranks of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] sometime before [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Eventually, Horst became an [[Officer/Legends|officer]], attaining the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Major/Legends|Major]]. Horst was assigned<ref name="Dietz" /> to the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Danuta]] at some point. [[Danuta research facility|The facility]] he protected, located in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Trid]], contained the [[Death Star plans/Legends|technical data]] for an Imperial [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] known as the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]], or as it later came to be known, the Death Star.<ref name="Dietz" />

As the Empire tightened its grip on [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], a band of freedom fighters known as the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] instituted [[Operation Skyhook]],<ref name="Star Wars: Dark Forces">''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]''</ref> a mission that would see the retrieval of the Death Star plans, so that they could be analyzed for a weakness in the [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] structure. The Alliance eventually hired the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Kyle Katarn]], along with with rebel [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Jan Ors]], [[Mission to Danuta|to invade]] the Danuta facility. Katarn also managed to persuade an old friend and Imperial officer [[Meck Odom]] to aid in the mission as well.<ref name="Dietz" />

One night that Major Horst was officer-of-the-day, Katarn eventually alerted the base to his presence. Major Horst had been assured by an officer (who would soon be dead) that he would intercept the rebel.<ref name="Dietz" />

Meanwhile, the security was disturbed by some minor explosion at the northern side of the perimeter, which was actually a makeshift bomb planted earlier by [[Jan Ors]] in order to create a diversion, and was enough to trigger some alarms. Horst assumed the issue was nothing more than a breach in the perimeter, but yearning for action against Rebels, Horst eagerly went to the task, along with the [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]] that was on duty, and two [[Squad/Legends|squads]] of [[Imperial_commando/Legends|Imperial commandoes]]. In his command car, he sighted Ors' ship, the ''[[Moldy Crow/Legends|Moldy Crow]]'', which intercepted the walker after a brief exchange of fire, before falling on the other car. It was too late when a shocked Horst ordered a retreat as his car was also shot down. The eager officer [[Death/Legends|perished]] in the resulting explosion. Katarn ultimately stole the Death Star plans,<ref name="Dietz" /> and eventually a weakness was exposed, allowing the rebels to [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destroy the Death Star]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Horst likened his charisma and abilities to that of a [[Wolf/Legends|wolf]], and after long working ours of nothing but patrol work, he was genuinely excited to see finally see some action. However, Horst underestimated his opposition due to a lack of intel, and was not prepared to go one-on-one with a [[Starship/Legends|starship]], which led to his death.<ref name="Dietz" />

==Behind the scenes==
Horst first appeared in the novella ''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]'' as a minor character. Horst later received an entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''. However, the [[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire audio drama'']] had a character named Horst who was completely different than the character described in the novella: a Major in charge of the night shift, who [[Horst (Keycard)|holds the Keycard]], whom Katarn confronts to steal the key.

This article assumes that the Danuta facility had two wholly different individuals named Horst.
